item.title: Quick Link List Item
item.description: Quick Link List Item The quick link list item is a fundamental component for displaying navigation links in a horizontal list format. It combines an icon, title, and optional description in a clean, accessible layout optimized for content-heavy interfaces. Overview The list item component provides a compact way to present quick links with comprehensive information. It supports both image and SVG icons, optional descriptions, and edit mode functionality for content management scenarios.
